ruleDefinitions.name: Potential Obfuscated Ordinal Call Via Rundll32
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects execution of "rundll32" with potential obfuscated ordinal calls

sequences.query: ((process_path = RGX("\\\\rundll32\\\.exe$") OR process_original_file_name = "RUNDLL32\.EXE" OR process_command_line = RGX(".*rundll32.*")) AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\#\\+.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\#\\-.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\#0.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\#655.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\#656.*")))
